- 修复利润页已删卡片名称不全、分享卡 logo 色边

changes.zh: 比值卡片的详情图恢复实时更新
changes.en: Ratio card detail charts update live again

changes.zh: 修复利润页已删卡片名称不全、分享卡 logo 色边
changes.en: Fixed truncated names of deleted cards on the Profit page and colored edges on the share card logo

changes.zh: 比值卡片的详情图恢复实时更新
changes.en: Ratio card detail charts update live again

changes.zh: 修复利润页已删卡片名称不全、分享卡 logo 色边
changes.en: Fixed truncated names of deleted cards on the Profit page and colored edges on the share card logo

changes.zh: 进阶机会阈值改为取成本下限、k 倍近期波动与历史分位三者最大，默认比之前高；k、分位、手续费和最低利润可在「关于本组 → 设置」中调整
changes.en: Advanced opportunity thresholds now take the largest of a cost floor, k × recent volatility and the historical percentile, so they are higher by default; k, percentile, fee and minimum profit can be set in About this group → Settings

changes.zh: 进阶机会新增扣成本净价差与资金费估算、超阈值后的回归时间统计，以及相关性骤降、单腿放量、单边漂移的风险提示
changes.en: Advanced opportunities add an after-cost spread and funding estimate, reversion-time statistics after threshold crossings, and warnings for falling correlation, single-leg volume surges and one-sided drift

changes.zh: 进阶机会改为三列布局，K 线移到右列
changes.en: Advanced opportunities use a three-column layout with candlesticks on the right

changes.zh: 账户同步异常、卡片持仓无法确认时，可以从自选移除卡片（移除前请到交易所核对仓位）
changes.en: Cards can be removed from the watchlist when account sync fails and their positions can't be confirmed (check positions on the exchange first)

changes.zh: 规模上限明确为单腿限额：策略设置新增联动的「合计」输入（合计 = 单腿 × 2），已保存的限额含义不变
changes.en: Size limit is now explicitly per leg: strategy settings add a linked Total input (Total = per leg × 2); saved limits keep their meaning

changes.zh: 进阶机会对已自选的配对显示与卡片同口径的偏离
changes.en: Advanced opportunities show the deviation of watched pairs on the same basis as their cards

changes.zh: 新增更新日志：更新前和设置 → 导出与关于中都能查看每个版本改了什么
changes.en: New changelog: see what each version changed before updating and in Settings → Export & About

changes.zh: 规模上限的单腿与合计分两行显示，五位数以上金额不再被截断
changes.en: Per-leg and total size limits are shown on two lines, so amounts of five digits or more are no longer cut off
